classification.difficultyReason: Translate a total length and a comparison of grouped lengths into two equations, then eliminate a variable.

content.prompt:
Solve this problem by introducing two pronumerals and forming a pair of simultaneous equations.

A ball of string of length 150 m is cut into 8 pieces of one length and 5 pieces of another length. The total length of three of the first 8 pieces exceeds that of two of the second 5 pieces by 2 m. Find the length of the pieces.

answer.short: The first 8 pieces are each $10\text{ m}$ long; the other 5 pieces are each $14\text{ m}$ long.
answer.worked:
Let $x$ metres be the length of each of the first 8 pieces and $y$ metres be the length of each of the other 5 pieces.
$$\begin{align*}8x+5y&=150 &&\text{(1)}\\3x-2y&=2 &&\text{(2)}\end{align*}$$
Multiply equation (1) by 2 and equation (2) by 5:
$$\begin{align*}16x+10y&=300 &&\text{(3)}\\15x-10y&=10 &&\text{(4)}\end{align*}$$
Add equations (3) and (4):
$$\begin{align*}31x&=310\\x&=10\end{align*}$$
Substitute into equation (2):
$$\begin{align*}3\times10-2y&=2\\30-2y&=2\\-2y&=-28\\y&=14\end{align*}$$
The first 8 pieces are each $10\text{ m}$ long, and the other 5 pieces are each $14\text{ m}$ long.

Check: $8\times10+5\times14=150$ and $3\times10-2\times14=2$.
